THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: Miri/1/19/83.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the LandAcquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the followinglands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 01 - 20 (Lots 20) allotmentsin total extent of about0.1811 Hectare of land in Preliminary Plan No. Gam: 3381 anddated 31.12.2014 prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent onbehalf of Surveyor- Gampaha, General situated in the Village ofMugurugampala in the Minor Division of Udugaha paththuwa ofDivisional Secretary’s Division of Mirigama in Gampaha District inthe Western Province.
